meta.title: AgentBridge — Pull Request Creation Sequence
meta.subtitle: End-to-End Flow from Mobile Trigger to GitHub PR Creation
meta.description: Sequence diagram tracing a remote Pull Request creation request from Telegram ChatOps through Control Plane, Permission Engine, Local Git topology inspection, and GitHub REST API execution.

participants.label: Telegram User
participants.description: Mobile engineer initiating Pull Request creation via ChatOps.

participants.label:
TelegramBotApp
(sutra/apps/telegram)
participants.description: Captures /pr command or [Create PR] button, verifies project context.

participants.label:
PermissionEngine
(sutra/permissions.py)
participants.description: Evaluates HIGH risk PR creation request and obtains human authorization.

participants.label:
ControlPlane
(sutra/control_plane)
participants.description: Routes authorized command frame over authenticated WSS connection.

participants.label:
LocalRuntime
(sutra/runtime)
participants.description: Validates project sandbox bounds and dispatches to Git Service layer.

participants.label:
Local Git Adapter
(sutra/git/local.py)
participants.description: Determines current branch, remote tracking topology, and commit status.

participants.label:
GitHub REST Adapter
(sutra/git/github.py)
participants.description: Parses owner/repo from remote URL, loads token from environment, posts to /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls.

participants.label:
GitHub API
(api.github.com)
participants.description: GitHub REST service creating pull request object and returning PR number and URL.
